title: Ryan Kwarteng (Dietitian) — Interim Order Review
text:
Order:
ORDER: The Interim Suspension Order made on 17 April 2025 is confirmed.

Notes:
This Order will be reviewed by the Committee no later than 20 April 2026 or earlier if new evidence which is relevant to the Order becomes available after it was made.
court: Health and Care Professions Tribunal Service
